〘 About 〙 
Welcome to DREAD CAMP, the scariest horror game on Roblox. Survive the aftermath of an expedition turned nightmare. Play alone or with friends to see if you can endure the terror together. Will you manage to keep your sanity intact?

〘 Updates 〙
🎉 Update 6/18 - Added Chapter Select, new Chapter 1 areas, and new tent accessories!

〘 Recommendations 〙
⚠️ WARNING: Contains flashing lights, loud sounds, and jumpscares
🎧📷 Headphones, max graphics, and high-end device recommended

🎵 Music is non-copyright, made custom for the game
❓ Join DREAD CAMP and enter a bus to start your expedition!

〘 Controls 〙
[E] - Interact
[Ctrl] - Crouch
[Shift] - Sprint
[1/2/3] - Equip item
[Left Click] - Use item

〘 Tags 〙
Horror, Puzzles, Mystery, Backrooms, Adventure, Friends, Exploration
